text: PROTOCOL AHA-202: Suspected Myocardial Infarction. Administer 324mg Aspirin chewed, 0.4mg Nitroglycerin sublingual (if SBP > 90). Do not administer Nitroglycerin if patient has taken erectile dysfunction medication within 48 hours.

metadata.keywords: chest pain, myocardial infarction, heart attack, stemi

text: PROTOCOL EMS-105: Hypotension/Shock. Administer 500mL Normal Saline bolus. Reassess BP. If cardiogenic shock suspected, limit fluid to 250mL bolus.

metadata.keywords: low blood pressure, hypotension, shock

text: PROTOCOL EMS-304: Active Seizure. Protect airway. Administer 5mg Midazolam IM or 2mg IV. Monitor respiratory status closely.

metadata.keywords: seizure, convulsions, status epilepticus

text: PROTOCOL EMS-401: Anaphylaxis. Administer 0.3mg Epinephrine (1:1000) IM. Consider 50mg Diphenhydramine IV/IM. Consider Albuterol for wheezing.

metadata.keywords: anaphylaxis, allergic reaction, throat closing, hives, anaphylactic shock

text: PROTOCOL EMS-502: Respiratory Distress. Administer Oxygen to maintain SpO2 > 94%. Consider Albuterol 2.5mg nebulized. Consider CPAP for severe distress or suspected pulmonary edema.

metadata.keywords: shortness of breath, respiratory distress, breathing difficulty, wheezing, asthma, copd

text: PROTOCOL EMS-601: Major Trauma. Stabilize C-spine. Rapid trauma assessment. Maintain SBP > 90. Cover bleeding with direct pressure or tourniquet. Rapid transport to Level 1 Trauma Center.

metadata.keywords: gunshot, stab, mvc, crash, massive bleeding, amputation

text: PROTOCOL EMS-602: Thermal Burns. Stop the burning process. Remove smoldering clothing. Cool burns with sterile water/saline for max 10 mins. Cover with dry sterile dressings. Administer fluid resuscitation based on Parkland formula.

metadata.keywords: burn, fire, scald, thermal injury

text: PROTOCOL EMS-701: Suspected Stroke (CVA). Assess Cincinnati Prehospital Stroke Scale (CPSS). Note exact time of symptom onset (Last Known Well). Rapid transport to Primary Stroke Center. Do not administer Aspirin.

metadata.keywords: stroke, cva, facial droop, slurred speech, weakness

text: PROTOCOL EMS-801: Opioid Overdose. Support ventilation with BVM. Administer 0.4mg - 2.0mg Naloxone (Narcan) IN or IV. Titrate to adequate respiratory rate, not necessarily full consciousness.

metadata.keywords: overdose, heroin, fentanyl, pinpoint pupils, unresponsive, narcan

text: PROTOCOL EMS-901: Hypoglycemia. If blood glucose < 60 mg/dL and patient is conscious/able to swallow, administer oral glucose. If unconscious, administer 10-25g Dextrose (D10 or D50) IV. If no IV access, 1mg Glucagon IM.

metadata.keywords: low blood sugar, hypoglycemia, diabetic emergency, altered mental status

text: PROTOCOL EMS-902: Hyperglycemia/DKA. If blood glucose > 250 mg/dL with signs of dehydration or Kussmaul respirations, administer 500mL Normal Saline bolus. Monitor ECG for peaking T-waves (hyperkalemia).

metadata.keywords: high blood sugar, hyperglycemia, dka, diabetic ketoacidosis

text: PROTOCOL EMS-1001: Cardiac Arrest (VF/pVT). Initiate high-quality CPR. Defibrillate ASAP. Administer Epinephrine 1mg (1:10,000) IV/IO every 3-5 mins. Administer Amiodarone 300mg IV/IO after 3rd shock.

metadata.keywords: cardiac arrest, dead, no pulse, vfib, ventricular fibrillation, pulseless

text: PROTOCOL EMS-1002: Cardiac Arrest (Asystole/PEA). Initiate high-quality CPR. Administer Epinephrine 1mg (1:10,000) IV/IO every 3-5 mins. Consider and treat reversible causes (Hs and Ts). Do NOT defibrillate.

metadata.keywords: cardiac arrest, flatline, asystole, pea, pulseless electrical activity

text: PROTOCOL EMS-1101: Pediatric Respiratory Distress (Croup). Administer humidified oxygen. If stridor at rest, administer 3mL Nebulized Racemic Epinephrine. Keep child calm. Rapid transport.

metadata.keywords: barking cough, stridor, croup, pediatric breathing, child respiratory

text: PROTOCOL EMS-1201: Obstetrical Emergency (Postpartum Hemorrhage). Fundal massage. Administer high-flow oxygen. Rapid fluid resuscitation with Normal Saline. Transport immediately to definitive care.

metadata.keywords: postpartum, bleeding after birth, maternal hemorrhage, childbirth complication

text: PROTOCOL EMS-1301: Heat Stroke. Move to cool environment. Remove restrictive clothing. Initiate rapid cooling (ice packs to groin/axillae/neck, or cold water immersion). Administer 500mL Normal Saline if hypotensive.

metadata.keywords: heat stroke, hyperthermia, hot, no sweating, heat exhaustion

text: PROTOCOL EMS-1302: Hypothermia. Move to warm environment. Remove wet clothing. Apply active external warming (warm blankets, heat packs to core). Handle gently to prevent V-Fib. Withhold IV meds if core temp < 86°F (30°C).

metadata.keywords: cold, freezing, hypothermia, frostbite

text: PROTOCOL EMS-1401: Toxic Exposure (Organophosphates). Ensure scene safety/decontamination. Administer Atropine 2mg IV/IM, double the dose every 5 minutes until airway secretions dry. Administer Pralidoxime (2-PAM) if available.

metadata.keywords: chemical exposure, organophosphate, pesticide, nerve agent, sludge syndrome

text: PROTOCOL EMS-1501: Crush Syndrome. Pre-hydrate with 1-2L Normal Saline prior to release of crushing object. Administer 50mEq Sodium Bicarbonate IV prior to release to prevent hyperkalemic arrest. Apply tourniquet if severe hemorrhage.

metadata.keywords: crush injury, pinned, trapped, compartment syndrome, rhabdomyolysis

text: PROTOCOL EMS-1601: Tension Pneumothorax. Perform immediate needle decompression using 14g or 10g 3.25-inch needle at the 2nd intercostal space mid-clavicular line, or 5th intercostal space anterior axillary line.

metadata.keywords: tension pneumothorax, collapsed lung, absent breath sounds, needle decompression, chest trauma
